question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bb.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bb.striker
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_match pm ON pr.match_id = pm.match_id 
    AND pr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON pr.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE pm.team_id != m.match_winner
